viperfish.note: Abyssal Viperfish and Glassjaw Viperfish are small-life sprite-frame runtime fauna. Saber Viperfish is a separate articulated source-candidate prototype and is not normal gameplay runtime without prototype review flow.

motionSystemFindings.finding: Generated articulated manifest is loaded at runtime; missing textures fall back to generated ellipse placeholders.
Normal gameplay allows accepted or legacy articulated manifests; all other prototype manifests require prototypeThreats/threats=prototype/playtest.
Motion uses phase-driven body/tail/fin/jaw waves plus attackBlend, swimEffort, stunned slowdown, and lunge/grab/recover states.
Socket overlays are dynamically bridged between parent/child anchors; severed overlays/detached states are supported where textures exist.
Large serpent-like threats use turn-history ripple following, but only selected IDs get that treatment.

qualityGateStatus.detail: Manifest texture size mismatches for abyssal-glasshook-skulk and abyssal-mandible-bobbit part/socket/wound textures.
First run timed out and wrote its default report outside run dir; rerun with allowed report path failed biome 4 because abyssal-reliquary-wyrm signature was not preserved.
Rendered representative contact and phase strips to articulated-proof.

qualityGateStatus.command: Playwright sandbox screenshots via Vite 5180 with watch ignored for .desktop-build
qualityGateStatus.detail: Captured idle/lunge/stunned screenshots for abyssal-gulper, abyssal-crownmaw, saber-viperfish, and abyssal-mandible-bobbit.

rankedConcerns.concern: Existing articulated validator fails on texture size mismatches. Both are normal legacy runtime, so this blocks a clean neutral-fauna-quality claim for articulated runtime.
No articulated creature is accepted for the content gate; even normal-spawn legacy threats carry quality.status=prototype and sandbox acceptedForContentGate=false.
Prototype spawn-budget smoke does not preserve the expected biome 4 signature encounter.
Several candidate rigs are 5-part starter articulations with generic root/body/tail/fin motion. They preview, but are explicitly review-only and need human motion/rig acceptance.
Contact/phase proof shows readable silhouettes, but motion mostly depends on global sine phase and socket bridges; detached/severed texture support is uneven outside the bespoke legacy rigs.

caveats: Read-only audit did not regenerate or modify source/assets/config/test files.
One existing smoke script wrote its default JSON report outside the requested run directory before the output path was overridden on rerun.
Screenshots are sandbox proof, not normal-play capture; normal-play canvas proof is covered by another lane.
